'''2001 Pennsylvania State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship held in Pennsylvania in 2001. [[Patrick Ziagos]] won it undefeated.<ref name="dt-16106">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/16106 DeckTech post 16106], DeckTech (Patrick "patziagos" Ziagos, 21 May 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/16106/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/16106/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 2001 (before 21 May)
* '''Site:''' Pennsylvania
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Patrick Ziagos]]

The event is known from players' DeckTech posts; they give no exact date. It was played before the [[Tatooine (expansion)|Tatooine]] expansion was released on 30 May 2001.

== Results ==

Results below come from players' own DeckTech deck posts. Each row cites the post that gives it. A Dark or Light cell shows — until the deck page is linked.

| 1st || [[Patrick Ziagos]]<ref name="dt-16106" /> || — || [[2001 Pennsylvania State Championship Patrick Ziagos LS|Tatooine: Obi-Wan's Hut start]]

Ziagos called it his undefeated Pennsylvania state championship deck. He beat Ray Bordier, the defending state champion, and [[T.J. Holman]], who was playing his DPC-winning My Kind Of Scum deck.<ref name="dt-16106" />
